exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing) — affirmative, interrogative and negative.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous (to be + fe'l -ing) — tasdiq, so'roq va inkor shakllari.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — TO'LIQ JADVAL

  TASDIQ            SO'ROQ                 INKOR
  I'm playing       Am I playing?          I'm not playing
  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  he's playing      Is he playing?         he isn't playing
  she's playing     Is she playing?        she isn't playing
  it's playing      Is it playing?         it isn't playing
  we're playing     Are we playing?        we aren't playing
  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  they're playing   Are they playing?      they aren't playing

UCH SHAKLNI SOLISHTIRING:
  TASDIQ:  ega + be + fe'l-ing
  SO'ROQ:  be + ega + fe'l-ing?   ('be' oldinga chiqadi)
  INKOR:   ega + be + NOT + fe'l-ing

DIQQAT: barcha shakllarda ASOSIY FE'L o'zgarmaydi —
faqat 'to be' o'zgaradi.

points.en: I'm playing. / Am I playing? / I'm not playing.
points.noteUz: 'I' bilan faqat AM. Inkori DOIM 'I'm not' — 'I amn't' YO'Q.

points.en: You're playing. / Are you playing? / You aren't playing.
points.noteUz: 'you' birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham ARE.

points.en: He's playing. / Is he playing? / He isn't playing.
points.noteUz: he/she/it → IS. Qisqartma: he's = he is.

points.en: She's playing. / Is she playing? / She isn't playing.
points.noteUz: 'isn't' = is not.

points.en: It's playing. / Is it playing? / It isn't playing.
We're playing. / Are we playing? / We aren't playing.
points.noteUz: we/you/they → ARE. 'aren't' = are not.

points.en: They're playing. / Are they playing? / They aren't playing.

exercises.instructionEn: Form, Use and Spelling of the Present Continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous yasalishi, ishlatilishi va imlosi.
exercises.explanationUz:
YASALISHI (Form):
  'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lning asos shakli + -ING

ISHLATILISHI (Use):
  1) HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish:
       I'm playing tennis now.
  2) Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA davom etayotgan ish:
       We're looking for a flat at the moment.
     (Aynan hozir qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
      lekin bu kunlarda shu ish davom etyapti.)

VAQT IFODALARI:
  now (hozir), at the moment (ayni paytda),
  at present (hozirda)

IMLO (Spelling) — UCH QOIDA:
  1) Ko'pchilik fe'l: shunchaki -ing → look - looking
  2) Ikki undosh ORASIDAGI bitta urg'uli unli bo'lsa,
     oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI → run - running
  3) -e bilan tugasa, -e TUSHADI → take - taking

points.en: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
points.uz: Present Continuous 'to be' fe'li bilan yasaladi va asosiy fe'lning asos shakliga -ing qo'shiladi.
points.noteUz: 'the base form' = asos shakl (lug'atdagi shakl).

points.en: We use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. — I'm playing tennis now.
points.uz: Present Continuous hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ishlatiladi. — Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.
points.noteUz: Bu — asosiy vazifasi.

points.en: We also use the present continuous for actions happening around the time of speaking. — We're looking for a flat at the moment.
points.uz: Present Continuous gapirish payti atrofida davom etayotgan ish uchun ham ishlatiladi. — Biz ayni paytda kvartira qidiryapmiz.
points.noteUz:
Aynan shu daqiqada qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
lekin bu davrda ish davom etyapti.

points.en: Time expressions used with the present continuous: now, at the moment, at present.
points.uz: Present Continuous bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ifodalari: now, at the moment, at present.
points.noteUz: Bu so'zlar gapda ko'rinsa — Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

points.en: Most verbs take -ing after the base form of the main verb. — look - looking
points.uz: Ko'pchilik fe'llar asos shakldan keyin -ing oladi. — look - looking
points.noteUz: 1-imlo qoidasi.

points.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ing. — run - running
points.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugagan fe'llar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantiradi. — run - running
points.noteUz:
2-imlo qoidasi: r-U-n → running.
Boshqa misollar: swim - swimming, sit - sitting, stop - stopping.

points.en: Verbs ending in -e drop the -e and take -ing. — take - taking
points.uz: -e bilan tugagan fe'llar -e ni tashlab -ing oladi. — take - taking
points.noteUz:
3-imlo qoidasi.
Boshqa misollar: make - making, shine - shining, write - writing.

exercises.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  Are you ...?   → Yes, I am.     / No, I'm not.
                   Yes, we are.   / No, we aren't.

  Is he/she/it ...? → Yes, he/she/it is.
                      No, he/she/it isn't.

  Are they ...?  → Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

QOIDA:
  Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', EGA OLMOSHI va
  'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi.
  Asosiy fe'l (-ing bilan) TAKRORLANMAYDI.

  TO'G'RI: Is he playing? — Yes, he is.
  XATO:    Yes, he is playing.  (takrorlanmaydi)
  XATO:    Yes, he's.           (tasdiqda qisqartma yo'q)

DIQQAT — SAVOL 'YOU' BILAN BO'LSA:
  Javob 'I' yoki 'WE' bilan beriladi — kimga qaratilganiga qarab.

points.en: Are you playing? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
points.noteUz: Bir kishiga qaratilgan savol → 'I' bilan javob.

points.en: Are you playing? — Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
points.noteUz: Bir necha kishiga qaratilgan savol → 'we' bilan javob.

points.en: Is he playing? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
points.noteUz: 'Yes, he's' XATO — tasdiq javobda qisqartma yo'q.

points.en: Is she playing? — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Is it playing? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Are they playing? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
points.uz: Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va 'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi. Asosiy fe'l -ing bilan takrorlanmaydi.
points.noteUz: 'a subject pronoun' = ega olmoshi (I, you, he, she, it, we, they).

exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous va Present Simple farqi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ZAMONNI SOLISHTIRISH — ENG MUHIM MAVZU

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS          PRESENT SIMPLE
  (be + fe'l-ing)             (fe'l / fe'l-s)

  HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan     ODAT va KUNDALIK tartib
  ish uchun:                  uchun:
    I'm studying now.           I go to work every day.

  Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA     DOIMIY holat uchun:
  davom etayotgan ish:          He lives in Manchester.
    He is working late
    these days.

VAQT SO'ZLARI BILAN FARQLASH:
  Present Continuous: now, at the moment, at present,
                      today, these days
  Present Simple:     every day, usually, always,
                      often, sometimes, never

MISOL — BIR FE'L, IKKI ZAMON:
  I'm studying now.        — hozir o'qiyapman (vaqtinchalik)
  I study every evening.   — har kuni kechqurun o'qiyman (odat)
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 30-bet, Present Continuous vs Present Simple

points.en: We use the present continuous for actions happening now. — I'm studying now.
points.uz: Present Continuous hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun. — Men hozir o'qiyapman.
points.noteUz: 'now' — Present Continuous belgisi.

points.en: We also use the present continuous for actions happening around the time of speaking. — He is working late these days.
points.uz: Present Continuous gapirish payti atrofidagi ish uchun ham. — U bu kunlarda kech ishlayapti.
points.noteUz: 'these days' = bu kunlarda — vaqtinchalik holat.

points.en: We use the present simple for habits or daily routines. — I go to work every day.
points.uz: Present Simple odat va kundalik tartib uchun. — Men har kuni ishga boraman.
points.noteUz:
'every day' — Present Simple belgisi.
'a habit' = odat; 'a daily routine' = kundalik tartib.

points.en: We also use the present simple for permanent states. — He lives in Manchester.
points.uz: Present Simple doimiy holat uchun ham. — U Manchesterda yashaydi.
points.noteUz:
'a permanent state' = doimiy holat (o'zgarmaydigan).
DIQQAT: 'He is living in Manchester' — vaqtincha yashayotganini bildiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the -ing form of the verbs below.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH QOIDANI ESLANG:
  1) oddiy -ing:        look → looking
  2) undosh ikkilanadi: run → running
  3) -e tushadi:        take → taking

Har bir fe'l uchun avval OXIRGI HARFLARGA qarang.

items.whyUz:
3-qoida: -E TUSHADI → shin + ing = shining.
'shining' = charaqlayotgan.

1-qoida: oddiy -ing.
DIQQAT: 'w' undosh, lekin ikkilanmaydi — undan oldin 'o' unlisi bor,
lekin 'ow' birga uzun tovush beradi.
3-qoida: -E TUSHADI → mak + ing = making.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in the negative and interrogative, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni inkor va so'roq shaklida qayta yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  He is playing football.
     He isn't playing football.      (inkor)
     Is he playing football?         (so'roq)

QANDAY O'ZGARTIRILADI:
  INKOR:  'be' fe'liga NOT qo'shiladi (qisqartiriladi)
            is → isn't,  are → aren't,  am → 'm not
  SO'ROQ: 'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDINGA chiqadi

ASOSIY FE'L (-ing bilan) HECH O'ZGARMAYDI.

DIQQAT — 'I am' ning shakllari:
  Tasdiq:  I'm going.
  Inkor:   I'm not going.
  So'roq:  Am I going?

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. is → isn't.
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. 'is' egadan oldinga chiqdi.

items.textEn: 2  They are wearing heavy jackets. — INKOR:
items.whyUz: Ko'plik ega → ARE → AREN'T.

items.textEn: 2  They are wearing heavy jackets. — SO'ROQ:
items.whyUz: 'Are' + ega + fe'l-ing?

items.textEn: 3  You are making a sandcastle. — INKOR:
items.whyUz: 'you' → ARE → AREN'T.

items.textEn: 3  You are making a sandcastle. — SO'ROQ:
items.whyUz: 'Are you ...?' — javob: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

items.textEn: 4  She is decorating the Christmas tree. — INKOR:
items.answer: She isn't decorating the Christmas tree.
items.whyUz: 'she' → IS → ISN'T.

items.textEn: 4  She is decorating the Christmas tree. — SO'ROQ:
items.answer: Is she decorating the Christmas tree?
items.whyUz: 'Is she ...?' — javob: Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Ob-havo gaplarida ega DOIM 'it' → IS → ISN'T.
'Is it raining?' — ob-havo haqidagi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan savol.

items.textEn: 6  I'm going on a picnic. — INKOR:
items.answer: I'm not going on a picnic.
items.whyUz:
'I am' inkori DOIM 'I'm not'.
'I amn't' — ingliz tilida YO'Q shakl.

items.textEn: 6  I'm going on a picnic. — SO'ROQ:
items.answer: Am I going on a picnic?
items.whyUz:
'Am I ...?' — 'am' egadan oldinga chiqadi.
'go ON a picnic' — 'on' predlogi shart.

patterns.exampleEn: He is playing football. They are wearing heavy jackets.

patterns.explanationUz: 'to be' egaga qarab o'zgaradi, fe'l doim -ING bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: He isn't playing football. I'm not going on a picnic.
patterns.exampleUz: U futbol o'ynamayapti. Men piknikka bormayapman.
patterns.explanationUz: NOT 'be' fe'liga qo'shiladi. Asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: Is he playing football? Am I going on a picnic?
patterns.exampleUz: U futbol o'ynayaptimi? Men piknikka boryapmanmi?

patterns.exampleEn: Is he playing? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Yes, he is playing' — asosiy fe'l keraksiz.
'Yes, he's' — tasdiqda qisqartma XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm studying now. / I go to work every day.
patterns.exampleUz: Men hozir o'qiyapman. / Men har kuni ishga boraman.
patterns.explanationUz: Vaqt so'ziga qarang: now → Continuous; every day → Simple.

Doimiy holatda Continuous ISHLATILMAYDI.
'He is living in Manchester' — vaqtincha yashayotganini bildiradi.
